seams.name: external-asset-owner-transfer-read

note: Investor parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). One capability is graded: the external-asset-owner transfer read. purchase_price_ratio is stored and returned as a decimal STRING (97.25) with no integer-minor-unit representation and no division/rounding surface on the read path, so it is not a money cell and carries no rounding surface.
